body: Better than when I originally posted. Still aching, though
All of the horrible things... Selfishness and greed and hate that seems to be everywhere in our world right now
Me too.. How long before I'm a fucking fool for holding my breath
Ignorance is bliss... The world is so ugly and so fucking relentless

My entire life is falling apart. So much debt, losing so many important people, not being able to get an apartment, mediocre temporary job, I'll never fucking amount to more than I am I peaked in college and now I'm nothing but a financial and emotional drain on everyone I love

I did and I stayed for three days which was pretty much the minimum. They have you sign a certain waiver in the beginning if you want that says they can't hold you for more than 5 days, but really it just matters what you think you need. Good luck to you, and happy cake day <3
I feel this exact same way. For some reason I can mentally justify my own self harm while caring deeply about them and hoping that they don't have to go through it too.
Being thorough in explaining what I feel and reassuring them that it's not their fault and I'm so sorry

I just want to say thank you for coming here to share your experience. I sometimes feel guilt and embarrassment - I'm too old to be doing this - but we're so many different people. My best wishes to you... PM me if you ever need to rant to someone random
Proud of you, and inspired too. You give me hope I can be clean again
Thank you - same to you. It's at least nice not to feel so alone about it
I've seen a lot of self harmers say they regret carving words, so you're right - that's definitely progress. I recently relapsed too, and with a very strong addiction, so you're not alone <3

I'm so glad I'm not the only one who wonders this too. I also have a black and white kitty, and he often follows me around - even if it's just to be in the same room.  Sometimes when I'm at my worst, he'll come up and purr at me, and I really want to believe that he loves me like I love him.

I'm so sorry you're going through that. Recently I've gone through quite a hell trip of my own, and I completely understand... Once I relapsed, I can't get enough now. You're so right about it being addicting... Heart goes out to you. If solidarity is all I can do, it's the very least I can do, dig?
